findings.message: 18 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "PARTY ACTIVE", "Thông báo", "Signed in as", "Biometric Acoustic Engine").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "Add to Playlist" 1:1 (#ffffff on #ffffff); "TẠO PLAYLIST" 1:1 (#ffffff on #ffffff); "Chia sẻ nội dung" 1:1 (#ffffff on #ffffff); "User" 1:1 (#ffffff on #ffffff)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.

findings.message: 5 typefaces in use (Inter, Material Icons Round, Material Symbols Outlined, Outfit, ui-monospace).
findings.fix: Two at most: one display, one text. Often one is enough.
Give every clip a poster frame: in the study of 100 Sites of the Day only 31% had one, and the blank or grey boxes before the clips played were recorded as faults (references/imagery.md §11).
Fix the URL or replace the asset.

findings.message: 2 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "Khám phá Station" (0px from the left); "Mood Station" (0px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: 3 panel shadow(s) heavy enough to read as floating: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px 25px 50px -12px | rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px 25px 50px -12px | rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px 25px 50px -12px
findings.fix: Panels sit on the ground: separate them with a fill one step from the ground or a quiet 1px border. A shadow, if any, is under 8% black with a small blur. Real overlays (menus, dialogs, popovers) may float.

findings.message: 136 text blocks under 11px: Signed in as 10px, Feed Mode 10px, Tracks 10px, Peers 10px.
1 pair(s) of cards in one row end at different heights (by 142px).
findings.fix: Cards that share a row share a bottom edge: balance them by their content (the same number of rows, a block of similar height beside it), or stack them. In testing, ragged rows were marked down every time.

findings.message: 3 card(s) hold a blank band inside: 518px in "close", 176px in "Calibrated Audio Stream", 49px in "KIETSTATION".
findings.fix: A card stretches to its neighbour only when it has content to fill. Keep a legend or a note directly under its chart (only an action or a total may sit at a stretched card's foot), let a short card keep its own height (align-items: start), and let a filtered block shrink to its rows.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Adaptive Mood Station" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "CALM / FOCUS" (screen 2, 100% hidden); "close" (screen 2, 100% hidden); "refresh" (screen 2, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: Page scrolls sideways by 100px at 390px. Widest offenders: div.absolute.top-10 (+100px).
findings.fix: Constrain the element that is wider than the viewport (max-width: 100%, or overflow: clip on its section).
